name: Chengdu Easton Biopharmaceuticals Co., Ltd.
summary: Chengdu Easton Biopharmaceuticals Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and commercialization of pharmaceutical products in China and internationally. The company offers active pharmaceutical ingredients; finished dosage forms, including capsules, tablets, and injections; pharmaceutical intermediates; biological drugs; and generic drugs. Its products are used in oncology, cardiovascular, neurology and psychiatry, anesthetic and analgesics, urinary, anti-inflammatory, anti-diabetes, anthelmintic, and antiemetic therapeutic categories. The company was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Chengdu, China.
